vision: The holistic development of the youth to carve out a better world by imparting value-based quality education for global competencies.
mission: To promote quality education, human values, research attitude, and ethical standard.
To create a healthy environment for academic excellence and overall personality development.
To foster global competencies, innovation, social responsibility, and scientific temper among youth.
To empower underprivileged and marginalized sections of society through inclusive education.

coreValues.title: Global Competence

coatOfArms.mottoMeaning: Love in Knowledge — derived from the Holy Father's maxim 'Caritas vestra magis ac magis abundet in scientia'.
coatOfArms.history: Before its foundation on October 9, 1946, the college received its motto from His Holiness the Pope: 'Caritas in Scientia' (Love in Knowledge). The seal features Saint Philomena, a Greek princess and virgin martyr discovered in May 1802 at the Catacombs of Priscilla.

symbols.meaning: Symbol of HOPE and steadfast faith — similar to the Holy Cross symbolizing Faith in Christ.
Symbolizes the fortitude and endurance of Saint Philomena through trials.
Symbolizes pristine purity, moral integrity, and virtue.
Symbol of glorious victory, academic triumph, and spiritual martyrdom.
Symbol of the scourge endured by Saint Philomena, standing for unwavering courage.

bishops.name: Most Rev. Dr. Rene Feuga
bishops.description: His Excellency, Rt. Rev. Dr. Rene Feuga, MEP, the first Bishop of Mysore, vacated his own episcopal mansion to make room for the first classrooms of St. Philomena's College on October 9, 1946. Together with Sri Jayachamarajendra Wodeyar, the Maharaja of Mysore, his vision laid the foundations of the premier higher education institution in Mysore region.

bishops.name: Most Rev. Dr. Mathias Fernandes
bishops.description: Bishop Mathias Fernandes spearheaded monumental infrastructure expansion, constructing the college auditorium in 1966 and the ground floor of the library block in 1981. It was during his tenure as Patron that the College celebrated its historic Silver Jubilee.

bishops.name: Most Rev. Dr. Francis Michaelappa
bishops.description: Most Rev. Dr. Francis Michaelappa guided the college through pivotal academic consolidations, fostering community outreach, moral education, and science laboratory modernizations.

bishops.name: Most Rev. Dr. Joseph Roy
bishops.description: Rt. Rev. Dr. Joseph Roy, the first local Bishop of Mysore, oversaw the grand Golden Jubilee celebrations, the construction of the iconic Octagonal Chapel in memory of Bishop Feuga, the campus perimeter wall, three floors of the library block, and the installation of Computer Science, Microbiology, and Biotechnology labs.

bishops.name: Most Rev. Dr. Thomas Anthony Vazhapilly
bishops.description: Under Bishop Thomas Anthony Vazhapilly, the college achieved Autonomous status in 2011, NAAC 'A+' accreditation with 3.58 CGPA, College with Potential for Excellence (2010), College of Excellence (2015), the Diamond Jubilee with President Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, and the monumental 1500-seat multi-purpose Indoor Stadium.

mdes.description: Mysore Diocesan Educational Society (MDES) is a Registered Society constituted to administer, manage, and coordinate the effective, efficient, and smooth functioning of 130 institutions from Nursery to Postgraduate levels across the Catholic Diocese of Mysore (covering Mysore, Mandya, Chamarajanagar, and Kodagu districts).
mdes.president: Most Rev. Dr. Francis Serrao SJ (Bishop of Mysore & President)
mdes.vicePresident: Msgr. Alfred John Mendonca (Vicar General & Vice President)
objectives: To promote quality education from kindergarten to postgraduate and research levels.
To foster moral character, civic discipline, and social consciousness in youth.
To establish institutions catering especially to rural, underprivileged, and minority communities.
To ensure ethical, transparent, and proactive institutional management across Karnataka.

rector.name: Rev. Dr. Lourdu Prasad Joseph
rector.title: Rector and Manager
rector.quote: St. Philomena's College established on October 9th, 1946 speaks volumes of its rich legacy, history and tradition. Now, 79 years young, traditional programmes coexist with contemporary courses, proliferating student strength and global competencies.
text: St. Philomena's College established on October 9th, 1946 with the benediction of His Excellency Rene Feuga MEP, the Bishop of Mysore and inaugurated with the munificence and generosity of His Highness Sri Jayachamarajendra Wodeyar, the Maharaja of the then princely state of Mysore, the first private science college in Mysore region speaks for itself volumes of its rich legacy, history and tradition.

Now, 79 years young, traditional programmes coexist with contemporary courses, proliferating the student strength and infrastructure. The college boasts of 27 UG depts. and 13 post graduate departments, offering academic excellence to students from all walks of life.
May God bless all our faculty, staff, and students as they strive for excellence and love in knowledge.

principal.name: Dr. Ravi J.D. Saldanha
principal.title: Principal
principal.quote: It is my immense pleasure to welcome you to our website and it is my special joy to take over as the Principal of a seventy-nine-year-old institution. It is both a humbling experience and a matter of pride.
text: It is my immense pleasure to welcome you to our website and it is my special joy to take over as the Principal of a seventy-nine-year-old institution. It is both a humbling experience and a matter of pride. This college is a living legacy of the magnificent foresight of our visionary predecessors.

They have played an important role in the all-round growth of the institution. Further, we have a multitude of gifts for which we are grateful: awesome heritage buildings, inspiring ex-teachers, dedicated faculty, committed non-teaching staff, illustrious students and of course our alumni who make St. Philomena's a citadel of learning.
I invite every student to explore their boundless potential and build a purposeful future at St. Philomena's College.

milestones.title: Inception & Foundation

milestones.title: Campus Auditorium
milestones.description: Construction of the grand College Auditorium during the tenure of Bishop Mathias Fernandes and Principal Rev. Fr. A. Fleury.

milestones.title: Silver Jubilee

milestones.title: Central Library Block
milestones.description: Construction of the dedicated Central Library under Principal Rev. Fr. Valerian D'Souza.

milestones.title: Platinum Jubilee (75 Years)
